    Roodepoort Little Theatre Productions brings Showvember Shenanigans to stage

    Local performers prepare to deliver a mix of musical numbers, unscripted comedy and intense drama over two days in Florida Park.

    24 hours ago
    Neliswa Sibiya 1 minute read
    Facebook X LinkedIn Tumblr Pinterest WhatsApp Telegram Share via Email Print
    Listen to audio version of this article
    Sponsored by
    0:00 / 1:33
    Instaread

    A comedy about the struggles of bringing a dramatic production to life will take centre stage when Roodepoort Little Theatre (RLT) Productions presents Showvember Shenanigans at the Roodepoort Theatre on November 20 and 21.

    Presented in partnership with the theatre, the production combines comedy, music and drama, with a line-up of local performers taking to the Basement stage.

    The cast includes Oriela van der Walt, Candy O, Josie Pelzer, Sean V, Ella Sidhoo, Crystal Kleer, Nick Jourdan, Jessica Geyser and Graham Shirley. Comedian Nadiem Solomon, a longtime friend and collaborator of RLT Productions, will host the show.

    Written by Hendrik Greyvenstein, the headline act The Ending is a comedy that takes a humorous look at the challenges of writing Any Final Request?, one of Greyvenstein’s acclaimed dramatic monologues.

    Previously staged as part of RLT’s 2022 Daydreams and Stage Memes season, the production returns by popular demand under the direction of award-winning Paul Violet. It explores the collision of writer’s block, artistic ambition and creative chaos.

    Adding an element of spontaneity to the programme, the RLT Improvistas will perform unscripted comedy inspired by the television show Whose Line Is It Anyway?. Audiences can catch the performances on Friday, November 20 at 19:30, and Saturday, November 21 at 14:30 and 19:30 at the Roodepoort Theatre Basement, situated at 100 Christiaan de Wet Road, Florida Park.

    Tickets cost R100 for adults and R80 for pensioners and students. Groups of 10 or more pay R70 per person, and bookings can be made at www.roodepoorttheatre.com.

    For enquiries, send an email to RLTProductions1950@gmail.com.

      How this consent management platform (CMP) works:

      CMP privacy choices

      Storage, duration and usage details

      The choices that you make with this CMP regarding the purposes and entities will affect how personalised advertising is presented to you. We need to store these choices to respect them on future visits, and they are stored differently based on the type of site or app that you're using:
      • For sites, your choices are saved in a cookie named 'FCCDCF' for a maximum duration of 390 days.
      • For apps, your choices are saved in device storage prefixed by 'IABTCF_'. Your choices will be invalidated after 390 days and overwritten once you make new privacy choices on this app.
      • For Accelerated Mobile Page (AMP) sites, your choices are saved in local storage prefixed by 'amp-store'. Your choices will be invalidated after 390 days and overwritten once you make new privacy choices on this site.
